data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 attempts to adjudicate §11.3 flag-sustention by appealing to a 'school-0 (mechanist) policy' under which verdicts lacking an explicit boundary function are 'mechanically void.' This policy is never established in the problem context — it is an imported, unsupported adjudicative standard. Furthermore, the claim that 'the harness cannot inspect a threshold that the critic never made explicit' is presented as a factual harness constraint without any grounding in the problem statement. §11.3 asks for adjudication of sustained flags, not application of an external mechanist policy under which verdicts become 'void.' SRC_001 thus fails the problem as stated by relying on an ungrounded policy framework to render a verdict, rather than directly adjudicating whether the flags are genuinely sustained.
